title: Contractor to Provide Upgrade to 1500 Ton Greenerd Press for Benet Laboratories, Watervliet, NY
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-DTA.W6QK ACC WVA
description_text: Contractor to provide services for upgrade of 1500 Ton Press to allow for autmated tube inspection and pressing system for Benet Laboratories per the Statement of Work. Service Contract Labor Standards do not apply. This is a sole source procurement with Greenerd Press and Machine Company. However, all responsible offerors may submit a quote which will be evaluated. Solicitation will result in a Firm Fixed-Price award.
